basis: Recognition output is supporting evidence only, not ground truth. Audio stays on this machine.
manual_procedure: Play the original file (not the processed one) with headphones.
Write down exactly what you hear, once, without looking at the expected phrase.
Compare with the declared utterance in audio/manifest.json and record the result in manual_listening.json.
A second listener makes the check more reliable.

bit.note: 1 of 2 engines agree; the others disagreed or returned low-confidence text. Treat as unverified until listened to.

engines.note: Whisper may write spoken letters as 'B-I-T'; comparison ignores punctuation.
